title: AI assists a minimax result for one-bit graph fingerprints
summary: The preprint reports an optimal worst-case distinguishing probability of 8/27 for a specified family of randomized graph fingerprints with three vertex roles and symmetric Boolean tables. It also classifies optimal tables.

evidence.tested: The manuscript reports computational checks alongside the mathematical argument.
evidence.unknown: Independent confirmation and the priority of overlapping results were not established.
evidence.ai_role: The provenance statement credits Astra Max with the initial construction and minimax theorem and GPT-6 with parts of the classification.
